5Licensed for one teacher, one classroom or one family. © Jurassic English
How to use these cards
What
they
are. 120 picture cards for the Word Fossil wall in Jurassic English™ Level 1 (ages 4 to 8).
Each card shows one word with an original picture, the English word and the Vietnamese word. 51
are the Word Fossils named in the Level 1 lesson plans; 39 more are feeling and character words of
the same kind; 30 are nature words for the Outdoor Reset and the eco-links.
Cut
and
keep. Print on A4 (card stock if you can). Each page holds 8 cards in a 2 by 4 grid; cut along
the dashed lines to make cards 85 mm by 60 mm. The last page has 8 blank cards for the Word
Fossils your learners dig up themselves.
Cách
dùng. In khổ A4, tốt nhất là giấy bìa cứng. Mỗi trang có 8 thẻ; cắt theo đường nét đứt. Trang cuối
có 8 thẻ trống để học sinh tự viết những Hóa thạch từ các em tìm được.
Using
them
with
the
Level
1
lessons. In each Excavation lesson, hold up the cards that match the
story. When a child ﬁnds a feeling word in the read-aloud, they ﬁnd the card, say the word, and the
card goes on the Word Wall. In the Justiﬁcation lesson, children use the cards as the ﬁrst blank of “I
think ____ because ____.”
Order
of
the
cards. 001 to 051 story fossils (in lesson order), 052 to 090 feelings and character words, 091 to 120 nature
words. The books are not included and none is quoted; the cards use only single words.
